title: Breaking: The Birds Are Spelling Things (Part 2)
description: The starlings left town overnight and reassembled over the next county, where they started spelling the names of everyone listening, in exact call-in order, beginning with Frank. Ronnie tries to host an aerial emergency while the flock works down the phone log, and Rhonda realizes the only way off the list is the one thing nobody wants to do.
